name: Arlinn Kord
description: A werewolf and planeswalker who can control her transformations and acts as an ambassador and protector of her kind.

timeline.summary: A lycanthrope strikes Mrs. Palter down, and Halana and Alena stab her dead.
timeline.quote: Together they plunged their blades into Mrs. Palter's raging, bloody form.

timeline.summary: A pack of werewolves surrounds them, but the leader changes into a human woman and sends the pack away.
timeline.quote: Suddenly the beast was a human woman

timeline.summary: The woman, who says she tracked Mrs. Palter, warns them to stop killing her pack and leave the Ulvenwald, since something worse is coming.
timeline.quote: I have seen enough, and so have you, to know that whatever is out there is worse than werewolves.

timeline.summary: The woman resumes wolf form and leaves; Arlinn Kord reflects she cannot have friends.
timeline.quote: in this life, Arlinn could not have friends.

timeline.summary: Arlinn, in wolf form, races toward the besieged town of Lambholt smelling angel's blood.
timeline.quote: The aroma met Arlinn's wide wolf nostrils as she raced up the sheer incline of a gorge toward the town of Lambholt under siege.

timeline.summary: Arlinn witnessed a mad angel's descent on Lambholt, which left cathars and civilians slain.
timeline.quote: She had witnessed the mad angel's descent on Lambholt from afar

timeline.summary: Flashback: Arlinn, secretly a lycanthrope, is presented the Mantle of Goldnight and made an archmage in the Elgaud chapel.
timeline.quote: At the correct moment, Arlinn bowed her head, and Reeves slipped the chain around her neck.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Arlinn hopes the blessing will repress her curse, since a lycanthrope cannot be an archmage.
timeline.quote: A lycanthrope could not be an archmage of Goldnight, and Arlinn had to become an archmage of Goldnight.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Cathar Leighton interrupts the ceremony with news of a devil attack on Havengul.
timeline.quote: Devils in Havengul! Hordes of them!

timeline.summary: Flashback: Rembert declares Arlinn an archmage and one of the Goldnight despite the unfinished ceremony.
timeline.quote: You are one of the Goldnight, Arlinn Kord, bound by the sacrament that holds us together

timeline.summary: Flashback: The Goldnight find Havengul ablaze with devils.
timeline.quote: They found the town of Havengul ablaze.

timeline.summary: Flashback: The angel Freydalia blesses a small church as a sanctuary for the injured.
timeline.quote: An angel, Freydalia, blessed a small church, casting a spell of protection over it

timeline.summary: Flashback: Arlinn prays to Avacyn and pulls a boy from under a collapsing carriage with divine strength.
timeline.quote: As the boy's hand touched hers, Arlinn yanked him out from under the carriage with a divine might that sent them both rolling across the ground just as the carriage collapsed.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Devils swarm Olaylie, cutting her and making her bleed.
timeline.quote: Olaylie was lurching through the sky with a devil on her back.

timeline.summary: Arlinn finds a mad angel bound in a clearing, surrounded by cathars.
timeline.quote: The angel was bound with rope, an arrow protruding from her gut, wings bloodied.

timeline.summary: Arlinn sees Rembert, whose three long scars shine in the moonlight.
timeline.quote: Though Rembert's face was red from effort and crusted in dirt, the three long, white scars that ran across his cheek and down his jaw shone in the moonlight.

timeline.summary: A branch snaps and the mad angel points out Arlinn the werewolf to the cathars.
timeline.quote: There in the trees! A monster!

timeline.summary: Distracted cathars step back, and the mad angel breaks her ropes and takes flight.
timeline.quote: In a display of mad strength, she spread her wings with enough force to cast off the ropes that bound her.

timeline.summary: Rembert attacks Arlinn with a branch and orders the cathars to kill the monster.
timeline.quote: Rembert was wielding the branch as a weapon, against her.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Arlinn hands the rescued boy to Rembert and races back to fight the devils attacking Olaylie.
timeline.quote: Archmage Arlinn Kord thrust the small child into Rembert's outstretched arms.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Devils pin Arlinn as she prays to Avacyn and receives no answer.
timeline.quote: She waited, opening herself to the power of the protector; she needed power to save the angel.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Olaylie's agonized cry makes Arlinn lose herself and transform into a werewolf.
timeline.quote: Arlinn felt the power of the pain in Olaylie's cry, and just like the night, she came apart.

timeline.summary: Flashback: The werewolf tears into the devils.
timeline.quote: The werewolf surged at the devils.

timeline.summary: Flashback: The werewolf pulls Olaylie down and attacks her.
timeline.quote: The werewolf pulled the angel back to the ground and laid into its flesh with teeth.

timeline.summary: Flashback: The werewolf kills the cathars who try to stop her, one by one.
timeline.quote: One after another. They all fell at the werewolf's mercy.

timeline.summary: Flashback: The werewolf tears the wings off Olaylie and kills her.
timeline.quote: Tore it full off the angel's body.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Rembert recognizes Arlinn, and she sees the bodies of Leighton, Reeves and the other cathars.
timeline.quote: Fallen cathars. Too many of them.

timeline.summary: Flashback: The werewolf slashes Rembert's cheek, leaving his scars, as he prepares to strike her down.
timeline.quote: her claws digging trenches into his cheek

timeline.summary: Flashback: As Rembert's sword falls, Arlinn planeswalks away to another world.
timeline.quote: she had planeswalked that day, so long ago, when her mind had cleaved.

timeline.summary: On another world Arlinn lives as a werewolf with a human mind and learns that she must trust herself to be whole.
timeline.quote: She had to trust herself to be whole.

timeline.summary: Arlinn returns to Innistrad, visits graves and confesses in churches and to angels.
timeline.quote: she had visited the graves, Reeves's, Leighton's, all of them.

timeline.summary: Arlinn tries to seek Rembert's forgiveness; he calls her a monster and orders her away from Elgaud Grounds.
timeline.quote: Leave these grounds, and never come back.

timeline.summary: Cornered at the gorge by Rembert and the cathars, Arlinn braces for blows.
timeline.quote: She was surrounded, backed against the edge of the gorge, cathars on all sides and Rembert before her

timeline.summary: Arlinn leaps up, pulls the angel to the ground and kills her, freeing Rembert.
timeline.quote: The mad angel was dead in the matter of moments.

timeline.summary: Rembert is wounded, lying on a dead tree trunk in the gorge, and Arlinn climbs out to reach him.
timeline.quote: Rembert was wounded, lying on a twisted trunk of a dead tree

timeline.summary: Arlinn transforms to human form and offers Rembert her hand; he admits she lied and killed the others, yet takes it.
timeline.quote: Arlinn closed her eyes and welcomed the transformation to her human form

timeline.summary: Arlinn tells Rembert that Avacyn is gone and they must find strength in each other.
timeline.quote: We must find strength in each other.

timeline.summary: Arlinn walks through a frozen Kessig village, noting that sundown comes sooner and sooner.
timeline.quote: Sundown comes sooner and sooner.

timeline.summary: Arlinn sits with Agatha, whose husband was killed, and promises to investigate the murders.
timeline.quote: even now as she tells his wife that she'll do her best to investigate these murders

timeline.summary: Agatha tells Arlinn that a witch is making effigies to help the village.
timeline.quote: That's the witch's doing.

timeline.summary: Arlinn recalls sparing a white stag and finding a skull left by Tovolar the next morning (flashback).
timeline.quote: there was a skull before them, resting atop a sword driven into the ground

timeline.summary: Arlinn's wolves lead her along carved boughs toward the witches' enclave.
timeline.quote: A series of crescents and rounds line it, shaped by a careful hand.

timeline.summary: Arlinn meets a false white stag and realizes it is a trick by Katilda.
timeline.quote: a stag, pure white, beneath a branch festooned with carved silver

timeline.summary: Arlinn finds the witches' enclave beneath an arch of the Celestus.
timeline.quote: she now sees an enclave: branches and hides fashioned into tents

timeline.summary: Katilda declares her people the Dawnhart Coven.
timeline.quote: We are the Dawnhart Coven.

timeline.summary: Arlinn names herself and says she wants answers before the dawn is gone.
timeline.quote: My name is Arlinn Kord

timeline.summary: Katilda explains the plan: return to Harvesttide traditions and gather people beneath the Celestus to restore the balance.
timeline.quote: Together, we can draw on our collective strength beneath the Celestus and, through it, restore the balance.

timeline.summary: Arlinn objects that gathering so many humans invites an attack.
timeline.quote: Putting that many humans in one place is begging for an attack.

timeline.summary: Katilda warns that without the proper ritual the night will overtake the day.
timeline.quote: then the night will overtake the day

timeline.summary: A rough, deep howl interrupts them, and Arlinn recognizes it as Tovolar's.
timeline.quote: A howl, rough and deep.

timeline.summary: In a flashback Arlinn, after her first change, sits with Tovolar, who tells her the woods belong to them; she suggests they could share them with the Kessigers.
timeline.quote: "These woods belong to us," he told her.

timeline.summary: Arlinn shifts into a wolf and runs after Tovolar and her wolves, answering his howl.
timeline.quote: She shifts before she knows what she's doing

timeline.summary: Arlinn remembers hearing Tovolar's howl as a girl and leaving her walled-in village at night for a life without fear.
timeline.quote: Under cover of night, she left.

timeline.summary: Arlinn finds Tovolar surrounded by huge wolves who have changed early, and asks who the newcomers are.
timeline.quote: "Who are these guys?"

timeline.summary: In a flashback Tovolar shows young Arlinn three torn-apart hunters and tells her that being free is worth whatever it costs.
timeline.quote: "Being free is worth whatever we pay for it," he answered.

timeline.summary: Arlinn sees that the wolves gathered around Tovolar are a new pack, not his old Mondronen one, and that something bigger than a hunt is being prepared.
timeline.quote: "Family," he answers. "Our new pack."

timeline.summary: Tovolar reveals he is getting ready to take the nights as well as the woods, hunting vampires and anyone else.
timeline.quote: "Getting ready to take what's ours," he says.

timeline.summary: Arlinn refuses to accept that wolves can do whatever they want, and Tovolar scorns her for having too much church in her.
timeline.quote: "Too much church in you," he growls. "Too little wolf."

timeline.summary: In a flashback Arlinn comes home to her mother, who says four boys were found torn apart in the woods, and Arlinn cannot bring herself to tell the truth.
timeline.quote: "Where were you?" she creaked.

timeline.summary: In a flashback Arlinn wakes after a hunt with a bolt-wound healed and the bodies of the village kids, now hunters, around her, and screams.
timeline.quote: Her mouth was slick with their blood.

timeline.summary: Arlinn raises a claw to strike Tovolar to delay his plans, but Boulder jumps in front of him and she pulls back.
timeline.quote: But before it can make contact, Boulder's in motion, jumping in front of him.

timeline.summary: Streak, Redtooth and Boulder side with Tovolar, and Arlinn sees that her wolves want to hunt.
timeline.quote: Streak joins him. So does Redtooth.

timeline.summary: In a flashback Arlinn finds refuge in the church, where friends help her feel safe, until Tovolar comes to morning services and sits beside her.
timeline.quote: Until he showed up to morning services.

timeline.summary: Arlinn locks herself in her room with holy symbols, but it is not enough, and she wakes elsewhere with the memory of blood.
timeline.quote: Arlinn locked herself in her room that night

timeline.summary: Arlinn sends Patience to join Tovolar so she can stay with the wolves and keep them safe.
timeline.quote: "Keep everyone safe," she says.

timeline.summary: Tovolar invites Arlinn to find him when she is ready for the new world and begins to shift; she leaves.
timeline.quote: Tovolar nods. "When you're ready for the new world, come find us."

timeline.summary: Arlinn returns to Katilda and agrees to get the key; Katilda welcomes her to the fire without remarking on the missing wolves.
timeline.quote: "I'll get your key," she says.

timeline.summary: At first light Katilda and her witches cast a calling for the coven's chosen champions while Arlinn sneaks off to Ravnica to find help.
timeline.quote: she sneaks off to Ravnica.

timeline.summary: Arlinn finds Jace absent from his house but is greeted by Teferi, who guesses she has not slept.
timeline.quote: "Take it you didn't just come here to keep me company, Arlinn," he says.

timeline.summary: Arlinn tells Teferi the nights on Innistrad are growing longer and something is coming, and Chandra leaps down the stairs to greet her.
timeline.quote: "The nights on Innistrad are getting longer, but that means no one's getting any rest."

timeline.summary: Kaya joins them with a joke about pencil on ink-only forms, and Arlinn laughs for the first time.
timeline.quote: "So, you're the one who used pencil on the ink-only forms?"

timeline.summary: Kaya, Teferi and Chandra agree to help and travel with Arlinn to Katilda's coven in the Kessig woods.
timeline.quote: They'll come. They'll help.

timeline.summary: Arlinn introduces her friends to Adeline and the assembled cathars, priests and Kessigers.
timeline.quote: "Adeline's fine.

timeline.summary: Arlinn suggests the church in Thraben may have taken the key, and the group decides to go there.
timeline.quote: She nods. "To Thraben, then."

timeline.summary: The party reaches the ruined Thraben cathedral and sees it overrun with the undead.
timeline.quote: The groans of the unhallowed dead answer Chandra before any of the others can.

timeline.summary: Kaya's research turns up a book showing the Betzolds being handed a box by a witch, and Arlinn recognizes Worrin Betzold's name as an old bishop.
timeline.quote: The caption labeled them the Betzolds, from Gavony.

timeline.summary: Adeline spots Worrin preaching to a congregation of zombies in the nave, and Arlinn confirms it is him.
timeline.quote: To Arlinn's horror, he seems to be preaching to a gathered crowd.

timeline.summary: Adeline and her cathars charge the horde while Teferi slows the undead and Chandra covers the rear with sheets of fire.
timeline.quote: Two great sheets of flame fly from her hands

timeline.summary: Arlinn questions the undead Worrin about the key, but he only answers with Dennick's name, and she puts him to rest.
timeline.quote: Arlinn gives Worrin the only rest she can

timeline.summary: In Gavony an old woman tells the group that Dennick, Worrin's son, holed up in the old family mansion.
timeline.quote: "He holed up in the old family mansion.

timeline.summary: Arlinn tells Dennick his father is dead and asks about the key; he says his great-grandfather gave it to a vampire of the Markovs for safekeeping.
timeline.quote: My great-grandfather gave it over to one of the vampires for safekeeping.

timeline.summary: Dennick names Sorin Markov as the prince who took the key, and Arlinn stays behind to listen to him.
timeline.quote: "It's the Markovs.

timeline.summary: Outside Markov manor Arlinn repairs a broken Avacynian symbol and begins a prayer, and her friends join in one by one.
timeline.quote: she rights the symbol and starts a prayer.

timeline.summary: The group crosses the broken bridge into Markov manor and makes its way toward the throne room.
timeline.quote: The bridge floats in pieces.

timeline.summary: Arlinn forces open the throne room doors and finds Sorin Markov reading on his broken throne.
timeline.quote: Sorin Markov sits with one leg slung over the broken throne of his house.

timeline.summary: Arlinn brings up Avacyn and Sorin slashes her arm with his sword, forbidding her to speak of her.
timeline.quote: She's not through the name before the sword's swinging through the air.

timeline.summary: Sigarda arrives in golden light and blocks Sorin's blow with her heron-headed scythe.
timeline.quote: A feather falls between them, gold and glowing

timeline.summary: Sigarda tells Arlinn the key is in Sorin's chambers on the third floor and fights Sorin so the others can go.
timeline.quote: You will find the Moonsilver Key in Sorin's personal chambers on the third floor.

timeline.summary: Teferi finds the Moonsilver Key in the hands of a headless statue of Avacyn, and Arlinn takes it.
timeline.quote: Arlinn takes the key.

timeline.summary: Feuer reports that he burned a vampire effigy, saw Arlinn Kord leading the search, and learned that the humans seem to have the Moonsilver Key.
timeline.quote: I recognized their leader. Arlinn Kord

timeline.summary: The heroes arrive to cheers, but a ward falls and howling begins.
timeline.quote: Deidamia feels the too-sharp pain of a ward going down.

timeline.summary: Howlpack shamans and hundreds of wolves attack the barriers while the witches usher the festivalgoers toward the center of the Celestus.
timeline.quote: doesn't see them beating against the barriers until the shaman-wolves are already upon them

timeline.summary: Arlinn sends Kaya off with the Moonsilver Key to deliver it to Katilda, and Chandra and Adeline ride to the front.
timeline.quote: "Kaya, take the key. Make sure it gets to Katilda."

timeline.summary: The magical barrier shatters and the wall of werewolves crashes into the festivalgoers.
timeline.quote: Overhead, the magic shatters like stained glass

timeline.summary: Teferi plants his staff and slows time to hold back the sunset, calling on the witches to start the ritual.
timeline.quote: "Witches of the Dawnheart Coven!" he bellows, "Let's get this ritual started!"

timeline.summary: Arlinn smashes a dire's knee with a mace and the cathars finish him, and the dire names her Tovolar's favorite.
timeline.quote: "You. Tovolar's favorite ."

timeline.summary: Arlinn remembers that after two years under Tovolar's tutelage she left him scarred and bleeding and ran away in the night.
timeline.quote: she left him scarred and bleeding then ran away in the middle of the night

timeline.summary: Arlinn confronts Tovolar and demands he call off the raid; he refuses.
timeline.quote: He smirks, shakes his head. "No."

timeline.summary: Arlinn attacks Tovolar with a mace, which he catches and tears from her hands.
timeline.quote: Tovolar catches the head of the mace.

timeline.summary: Arlinn punches Tovolar and offers to let him take the nights back if he spares the humans, but he rejects it.
timeline.quote: Take the nights back, hunt what you can, but leave the humans out of this.

timeline.summary: Tovolar transforms and presses her; Arlinn takes a sword from a fallen guard and Tovolar claws her cheek.
timeline.quote: his claws tear open her cheek.

timeline.summary: Arlinn recalls the night she challenged Tovolar for the alpha position and the scar she gave him.
timeline.quote: And then she'd be the alpha of the howlpack.

timeline.summary: Her wolves close in and Patience begs Arlinn to join the hunt; Arlinn says she cannot, and Boulder bowls her over.
timeline.quote: True to his name, when he throws his weight against her, she's bowled over

timeline.summary: Tovolar pins Arlinn and demands she show him the real Arlinn; the sun sets and Arlinn changes into a wolf.
timeline.quote: The sun sinks below the horizon. Day changes to night.

timeline.summary: Arlinn remembers returning home years ago to find her family's forge burned to a husk.
timeline.quote: A husk meets her: blackened foundations jutting from the earth.

timeline.summary: Arlinn, in wolf form, attacks Tovolar at the festival and he throws her to the ground.
timeline.quote: Forward. Powerful legs send her flying through the air

timeline.summary: Tovolar slams Arlinn into a split tree trunk, and she tears out a piece of wood and drives it through his leg.
timeline.quote: she has pierced him all the way through

timeline.summary: Streak, Redtooth and Boulder pin Arlinn down, and she is stunned by a blow to the head.
timeline.quote: there is Streak with his jaws firmly locked on her already wounded shoulder

timeline.summary: Tovolar urges Arlinn to join the hunt and says that the Church hates part of her but the pack does not.
timeline.quote: "Join the hunt," he says.

timeline.summary: Arlinn tells Tovolar she is home so he lets her up, then drives her claws into his sternum.
timeline.quote: She drives her claws deep into his sternum.

timeline.summary: Arlinn tells Tovolar Innistrad is home, and he calls her a liar.
timeline.quote: "You lied," he rasps.

timeline.summary: Tovolar agrees to call off the attack, and the wolves howl a retreat.
timeline.quote: The howl goes up soon after that, a call for retreat only the wolves understand.

timeline.summary: Arlinn surveys the aftermath, which survivors call the Harvesttide Massacre, and resolves that the ritual must be completed.
timeline.quote: the word has already been formed: massacre .

timeline.summary: Chandra and Adeline pick up the wounded Arlinn and take her to the Celestus.
timeline.quote: Shifting to her human form, Arlinn takes Chandra's hand.

timeline.summary: The witches call Arlinn as the Child of Blood and Fang and ask whether she will spill blood for the day; she agrees.
timeline.quote: "Child of Blood and Fang. You stand on the line of Dawn, where Night and Day meet."

timeline.summary: Arlinn anoints the bowl of the Sungold Lock with her blood and a bitter herb, and the Celestus stirs to life.
timeline.quote: So, too, does the Celestus.

timeline.summary: Olivia Voldaren crashes down in a streak of red and gold, seizes Katilda and reaches for the key; Arlinn dives and secures it.
timeline.quote: Katilda swallowed up in its impossible color.

timeline.summary: Olivia offers to trade Katilda for the key and cuts her chest to force a decision.
timeline.quote: she rakes her claws across Katilda's chest.

timeline.summary: The witches say the ritual had to be done by Katilda, so Arlinn throws the key to Olivia.
timeline.quote: Arlinn hurls the key with her good arm.

timeline.summary: Olivia throws Katilda toward the altar, injuring them both, and flies away with the key.
timeline.quote: By the time the world stops spinning, the vampire is gone.

timeline.summary: The group finishes its fifth counterattack of the week at a village, where Arlinn cares for a boy who ran to them.
timeline.quote: This is the fifth counterattack they've launched this week.

timeline.summary: Arlinn tells the group they cannot keep fighting like this, and Teferi says he cannot hold the moon in place with Innistrad's ancient magic.
timeline.quote: "There's no song and dance about it," she says. "We can't keep this up."

timeline.summary: Arlinn argues that the endless night will starve the vampires too and proposes visiting Sorin Markov.
timeline.quote: "The endless night doesn't just affect humans."

timeline.summary: Adeline agrees to go to Sorin, hoping a trace of Avacyn remains in him, and comforts the boy from Karo.
timeline.quote: "I'll go. If there's a trace of Avacyn left in him, he'll listen."

timeline.summary: Sorin finds Arlinn and the others trespassing in his library.
timeline.quote: All in his library, in his family archives

timeline.summary: Sorin reveals the invitation to Olivia Voldaren's wedding and that she has stolen Edgar; if they marry she will rule all of Innistrad.
timeline.quote: "She's stolen my grandfather.

timeline.summary: Arlinn reads the invitation and declares the group will crash the wedding.
timeline.quote: "Looks like we've got a wedding to crash."

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch and allies reach the gates of the Voldaren Estate, but the guards admit only one person per invitation.
timeline.quote: "One person per invitation," the guards intone together.

timeline.summary: Chandra remembers the Harvesttide Massacre and agrees they cannot fight without the key; Sorin agrees to enter alone.
timeline.quote: "I've been alone for centuries," he says. "This will be no different."

timeline.summary: Outside, the allies joke about whether there is cake at a vampire wedding.
timeline.quote: "Do you think there's cake in there?"

timeline.summary: A beam of light shatters Voldaren Manor's windows and the invitation wards crumble, and Arlinn orders the assault.
timeline.quote: she shouts to the others, "Now!"

timeline.summary: The assault force charges across the bridge, overwhelming the gate guards and downing swarms of bats with magic and arrows.
timeline.quote: As the bats descend, hungry for blood, the witches and archers are eager to meet them.

timeline.summary: Kaya senses angry spirits and hears Katilda calling, and goes to free the geists while Arlinn presses on.
timeline.quote: "I'll see about our backup. It's time the Voldarens paid their debts."

timeline.summary: The assault force tears through the guards and furnishings of the manor.
timeline.quote: Vampires built this place on the backs of mortals.

timeline.summary: Arlinn reaches the ballroom, sees Sigarda reaping vampires, and spares a Markov duelist rather than kill him as Tovolar would.
timeline.quote: Arlinn hefts him overhead and hurls him into a column.

timeline.summary: Cathars crash through the windows and the crowd demands the key; Olivia rages at the destruction of her wedding.
timeline.quote: "You . . . all of you! You're ruining my wedding day !"

timeline.summary: Kaya stabs Olivia's train, freeing the geists bound within it, and Olivia flees into a hallway.
timeline.quote: Kaya plunges a spectral dagger into Olivia's fell train.

timeline.summary: Arlinn chases Olivia through the portrait-lined corridors and corners her in a dead end, where she claws her.
timeline.quote: With a human howl, she lashes out

timeline.summary: Olivia cuts Arlinn's fingers and stabs her chest with a gilt sword, taunting her for being alone.
timeline.quote: "You're all alone here."

timeline.summary: Arlinn changes into her wolf form and fights Olivia, hurling her through a statue.
timeline.quote: Senses sharpen. Strength returns to her as she grows

timeline.summary: Distracted by tearing at the portraits, Arlinn is staked by Olivia from behind and falls.
timeline.quote: How ironic—a vampire's stiffened hand makes for an excellent stake.

timeline.summary: Kaya points Tovolar to the door where Arlinn went, and he bounds toward her.
timeline.quote: Tovolar's gone the second she's done talking

timeline.summary: Arlinn dreams of forests and wakes to find Tovolar and her four wolves around her.
timeline.quote: When she opens her eyes, Tovolar is the first thing she sees

timeline.summary: Arlinn tells Tovolar their grievance is unsettled and he proposes that they settle it afterward.
timeline.quote: "Tovolar," she says, "this doesn't change anything between us.

timeline.summary: Arlinn and her wolves track Olivia and corner her with Edgar, and Olivia drops the Moonsilver Key and flees.
timeline.quote: But she drops the key.

timeline.summary: Arlinn takes the key in her teeth and tells Tovolar to come find her later.
timeline.quote: Arlinn wraps the key with a length of torn curtain and picks it up between her teeth.

timeline.summary: On the journey from Stensia to Kessig, Arlinn tells Katilda about Tovolar and werewolf fear and how Harvesttide set things back.
timeline.quote: "It isn't until you get some distance that you realize they're wrong.

timeline.summary: At the Celestus Arlinn joins the key and the Sungold Lock, and the Celestus roars to life.
timeline.quote: But that worry dies the instant gold meets silver.

timeline.summary: A column of light runs to the moon and the sun rises over Innistrad for the first time in months.
timeline.quote: Together they watch the first sunrise over Innistrad in months.

timeline.summary: Arlinn says farewell to her friends, and Kaya leaves, promising to return for ghost business.
timeline.quote: "It's been nice working with you, Arlinn."

timeline.summary: Teferi borrows the Moonsilver Key and warns Arlinn about Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: "They're called Phyrexians.

timeline.summary: As a teenager Arlinn first succumbs to the werewolf within her and for years tries to hide what she is.
timeline.quote: Arlinn Kord was a teenager when she first succumbed to the primal call of the werewolf inside her.

timeline.summary: After becoming a planeswalker, Arlinn discovers she can control her transformations.
timeline.quote: after becoming a Planeswalker she discovered the power to control her transformations.

timeline.summary: Arlinn becomes an ambassador and protector of werewolves, brokering a tentative peace with humans.
timeline.quote: Now, she has become an ambassador and protector of her kind

relations.note: She commands the pack with a shake of her head.
relations.quote: The woman shook her head once, short and sharp.

relations.note: Arlinn threatens to move against them if they keep killing her pack.
relations.quote: If you do not, I will be forced to move against you.

relations.note: He pushed and helped hone her strengths.
relations.quote: a mentor who had pushed her, been patient with her, and helped her to hone her strengths

relations.note: Declared one of the Goldnight by Rembert.
relations.quote: You are one of the Goldnight, Arlinn Kord, bound by the sacrament that holds us together

relations.note: In werewolf form she rips her wings off.
relations.quote: away from the broken, bloodied, lifeless angel Olaylie

relations.note: Among the cathars killed during her transformation.
relations.quote: away from the body of Archmage Reeves at her feet

relations.note: Among the fallen cathars she recognizes.
relations.quote: She knew them all. Leighton. Reeves.

relations.note: Estranged since she scarred him, he banishes and then fights her, but she saves his life.
relations.quote: If I ever see you again, I will strike you down.

relations.note: She is its protector.
relations.quote: She was the protector of the Ulvenwald.

relations.note: Their howls cursed her with lycanthropy.
relations.quote: after the howls of the Mondronen werewolf pack had cursed her

relations.note: Streak is part of Arlinn's wolf pack.
relations.quote: He is the fastest of her pack.

relations.note: They split long ago; each found a pack.
relations.quote: He found his pack, and she found hers.

relations.note: Arlinn was formerly an Avacynian priest.
relations.quote: As an Avacynian priest, Arlinn knew well how strong the Archangel's protection had been.

relations.note: Tovolar guided Arlinn through her first hunts.
relations.quote: On the first hunt, she ran with Tovolar.

relations.note: She tries to strike him down to stop his plan for the pack.
relations.quote: She has to stop him.

relations.note: Teferi agrees to help her.
relations.quote: "Take it you didn't just come here to keep me company, Arlinn," he says.

relations.note: Chandra is a friend who comes to help.
relations.quote: "Arlinn!" she calls, plopping herself down at one of the tables next to them.

relations.note: Kaya agrees to help find the key.
relations.quote: The stranger's name is Kaya

relations.note: Arlinn promises to get Katilda's key.
relations.quote: "I'll get your key," she says.

relations.note: He was a strict instructor in theology at the cathedral.
relations.quote: Worrin in life was as strict an instructor as they came.

relations.note: He taught her to give in to her instincts.
relations.quote: Give in to your passions and your instincts

relations.note: Arlinn's faith summoned Sigarda.
relations.quote: it is your faith that summoned me here.

relations.note: She spent two years under his tutelage.
relations.quote: after two years under his tutelage

relations.note: She fights him to stop the raid.
relations.quote: "Tovolar!" she shouts. "Call this off!"

relations.note: Teferi buys time for Arlinn.
relations.quote: "I was going to tell you I owed you a long sunset."

relations.note: He looked after her when she first changed.
relations.quote: The Tovolar who looked after her has grown into the Tovolar who attacks innocents

relations.note: She stops his attack by wounding him.
relations.quote: "Innistrad is home, Tovolar," she says.

relations.note: He recommended her for the Archmagi.
relations.quote: He was the one who recommended her for the Archmagi.

relations.note: She takes the key and Katilda against Arlinn's side.
relations.quote: "I've got your witch; you've got my key."

relations.note: Chandra helps her to the ritual.
relations.quote: "You're in bad shape, come with us!"

relations.note: Kaya works with her at the ritual.
relations.quote: Kaya's at Arlinn's side in an instant.

relations.note: He warned her to mind herself in the woods.
relations.quote: "Mind yourself in the woods, Arlinn," he says.

relations.note: Their fight has worn on her.
relations.quote: that, and whatever drove her fight with Tovolar

relations.note: She fights and impales her.
relations.quote: " You ," Olivia sneers. "Why did you have to come?"

relations.note: They fight together.
relations.quote: Kaya's hand on her shoulder brings her back to the present moment

relations.note: Katilda's spirit leads the geists and guides Arlinn.
relations.quote: And among the crowd, a familiar headdress stands out: Katilda.

relations.note: Arlinn trusts that Sorin will do the right thing.
relations.quote: And—Avacyn's mercy—she trusts Sorin, too.

relations.note: Uneasy temporary allies against Olivia, with a grievance still unsettled.
relations.quote: Arlinn's skin crawls.

relations.note: Her wolves rejoin her pack.
relations.quote: Boulder's at her side, too—they all are.

relations.note: Katilda follows the group and advises Arlinn.
relations.quote: "I would give you advice, Arlinn," Katilda says.

relations.note: They worked together.
relations.quote: "Nice working with you, too," Arlinn says.

relations.note: They set up defenses together.
relations.quote: Thalia has found herself working with Arlinn Kord to set up defenses all over the plane.

pages_say.description: A werewolf who leads a pack, can change form in battle, saves Halana and Alena from Mrs. Palter, and warns them to leave the Ulvenwald.

A werewolf planeswalker and protector of the Ulvenwald who once concealed her lycanthropy as an archmage of Goldnight, slaughtered her comrades during a transformation, and now returns to save Rembert.
A werewolf planeswalker and former Avacynian priest who protects Kessig villages and investigates new, larger werewolves as Innistrad's sun dims.
A planeswalker and werewolf from Kessig on Innistrad who relives her first hunts with Tovolar, loses her wolves to his pack, and asks her friends for help.
A planeswalker and werewolf from Innistrad who leads her friends in search of the Moonsilver Key, drawing on her old faith in the Church.
A planeswalker and werewolf who defends the Harvesttide festival and fights her old mentor Tovolar, finally changing under the night sky.
A planeswalker and werewolf who defeats Tovolar by a trick, then gives her blood for the Harvesttide ritual and throws the key to Olivia to save Katilda.
A planeswalker and werewolf who leads the counterattacks and proposes asking Sorin Markov for help.
A planeswalker and werewolf who proposed bringing Sorin as a wedding guest.
A planeswalker and werewolf waiting outside the gates with the rest of the allies.
A planeswalker and werewolf who leads the assault on Voldaren Manor and chases Olivia, then is impaled by her.
A planeswalker and werewolf who recovers the Moonsilver Key from Olivia with her wolves and completes the ritual that returns the sun to Innistrad.
A planeswalker who works with Thalia on defenses.
A werewolf and planeswalker who can control her transformations and acts as an ambassador and protector of her kind.
